content:
Customer conversations are always the most valuable part of events like this!

We appreciated the opportunity to connect with so many customers at this year’s U. S. Steel Tubular Products Customer Seminar, hear their perspectives and spend time discussing the opportunities and challenges shaping our industry.

Thanks to everyone who joined us. And for those who couldn’t, I encourage you to take a look at the highlights video below and reach out to find out when next year’s event will be held. 

https://lnkd.in/gr9x5Udi 

#USSteel #Tubular #Manufacturing #Energy #AmericanManufacturing
personaInterest: Rencontres avec les clients et discussions sur les opportunités et défis de l'industrie
keyTakeaway: L'entreprise a organisé un séminaire pour les clients de U. S. Steel Tubular Products et souhaite renforcer les liens avec ses clients.
